title: flywheel: flywheel_emit_codex input
description: Emit the Claude Code plugin skills as a Codex-native bundle under a target directory inside cwd. Writes AGENTS.md plus .codex/skills/<name>.md without modifying the source skills.

targetDir.description: Destination directory inside cwd, relative or absolute

pluginRoot.description: Optional plugin source root. Must be inside cwd or match CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT.
